notes: drawChart retried on a 100ms timer whenever its canvas measured under 10px, including the case where the market tab is simply hidden. _pushWave schedules drawChart on every price tick regardless of the open tab, so each tick started its own self rescheduling chain that never terminated. Guarded on offsetParent, and the mobile shell now nudges a redraw when Market becomes visible. CLIENT only, no restart needed, hard refresh required.
